decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line has its own page and sits close to the core natural skincare offer, so after only one year on the market this small firm has every reason to keep building it.
A hyaluronic acid serum is a staple, in-demand facial product that fits the firm's facial range, although its lower website prominence makes a quiet discontinuation slightly more likely.
A cleansing milk is a basic part of any facial care routine and is cheap to keep in a small-batch, in-house production setup, so there is little reason to drop it soon.
